title: Coherent precipitation of cuboidal nanoparticles in Al1Ti5Zr4Nb3Ta3 lightweight refractory high entropy alloy based on laser metal deposition
process_description: prepared by laser metal deposition using spherical pre-alloyed powder prepared by plasma rotating electrode process (PREP). The alloy was fabricated under optimized processing conditions with laser power P = 1400 W and laser scanning rate V = 500 mm/s.
